goal: 在P0、P1、SnAr+HPLC三组8任务上完成可前瞻检验修订的知识闭环，在大多数任务建立相对匹配纯BO的搜索优势，完整披露失败和退化。

comparison.base_acquisition: qLogEI q=1, MC512; exact shared implementation within task
comparison.continuous_GP: existing SingleTaskGP (continuous limit of Mixed GP)
comparison.categorical_GP: shared nominal Mixed GP recipe to be source-pinned before running; any structure-kernel recovery must be shared by BO and agent
comparison.tie_policy: same no-ID-rank rule for BO and agent; independent tie RNG
comparison.initialization: each task own frozen four points; BO and agent start independently without protected optimized prefixes

acceptance.performance: Primary criterion: at least5 of8 real-Agent tasks have SearchAUC strictly above matched BO (1e-9 numerical tolerance, equality not a win). Final best, signed changes, losses and all8 trajectories must be reported; no all-task or20-scenario noninferiority requirement.
acceptance.SearchAUC: mean cumulative best over 16 added queries, including initialization in incumbent
acceptance.mechanism: Audit all6 loop steps and substantiate actual prospective evidence-supported knowledge decisions. Distinguish optional verification, weighted knowledge and BO fallback; neither pure fallback nor posthoc selection of winners establishes knowledge benefit.
acceptance.reporting: Separate8 real-Agent tasks and12 artificial stress conditions; report case-level SearchAUC/final best, uncertainty and degradation; do not pool unlike units or count equality as superiority.
acceptance.independence: seed0 development is not independent confirmation; freeze code/prompts/thresholds then register a fresh held-out paired seed before any stability claim; never reuse failed holdout as confirmation
acceptance.promotion: Promote one globally fixed policy only after majority performance and mechanism evidence; do not choose a different winner per case; preserve failed variants.
acceptance.stress: Twelve artificial P0 conditions remain robustness diagnostics and are not counted as additional independent tasks or required to all pass.

steps: 提出有范围和语义身份的可检验知识
在结果揭示前保存基础GP和知识条件预测
提交选点后仅揭示该点真实反馈
按冻结预测相对GP的增量更新权重
依据反馈保留/修订/撤回，空覆盖则休眠
只在共同qLogEI机会预算内影响下一次选点
design.coverage: review all hypotheses before selecting one; require unqueried eligible support; evaluate whether allowed weight could change ranking; never enlarge scope after observing outcomes
design.verification: prefer free shadow feedback at BO points; active tests are optional, require material extra information and another remaining actionable candidate; no out-of-gate exception in first prototype
design.versions: retain semantic ID, version/parent, prequery evidence IDs and negative constraints; no double-count/relabel reset; revised claims cannot earn retrospective positive evidence
design.events: feedback-driven refresh on exhausted actionable support, material counterevidence or stall, plus reserved late capacity; refresh and deployment independently logged
design.categorical: real names/SMILES and equality/sets; no arithmetic direction or distance on arbitrary category codes
design.llm_cache: reuse same response for identical public prefix+prompt+model+effort+menu across ablations; never share across divergent histories
design.risk: acquisition opportunity constraint is not a theorem of no realized loss

implementation_status: v2 implemented and independently audited, now evaluate explicit public domain/units and synchronized current coverage. Full and deployment-only remain matched predeclared arms.
revision_authority: User: 不要求全部case超越bo,要求大部分超越，建立优势即达到目的
